mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns when FEDFUNDS is below 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 3.0%, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns when FEDFUNDS exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of federal funds rate above 2.5% and unemployment rate above 5.0% signals dual stress on monetary policy and labor market, reducing corporate profitability and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns when FEDFUNDS > 2.5% AND UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.5%), labor market weakness suppresses consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in periods when UNRATE > 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of total nonfarm employment compresses labor market tightness and supports consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns when PAYEMS is above 135,000 (thousands).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 900,000 units, it signals weak residential construction and reduced consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns when HOUST is below 900.0.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 900,000 units combined with industrial production below 110 signals a broad-based economic slowdown, reducing corporate earnings and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns when HOUST < 900.0 AND INDPRO < 110.0.

mechanism_narrative: In a strong economic expansion (GDPC1 level above 11500.0), robust GDP growth supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns when GDPC1 exceeds 11500.0.
